query:
SELECT o.id AS option_id,
                      COALESCE(array_agg(v.user_id ORDER BY v.created_at, v.user_id)
                               FILTER (WHERE v.user_id IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS "user_ids!"
                 FROM poll_options o
                 LEFT JOIN poll_votes v ON v.option_id = o.id
                WHERE o.poll_id = $1
                GROUP BY o.id, o.position
                ORDER BY o.position
